name: Tsukamoto Itsuki
source:
Youko’s older brother. Quiet to an almost unnatural degree. Only Shinobu, Youko, and a handful of others can really understand what he’s saying when he speaks. He’s stoic by nature and places great importance on honor and righteousness. There’s an air of old maturity about him, along with a tendency to give up quickly-but among close friends, a surprisingly childlike side sometimes slips through. He holds ranks in kendo and also studies iaido. Raised in a strict household where he never knew freedom, meeting Shinobu gave him a place where he could finally spread his wings.

[From the [https://web.archive.org/web/20240521122532/https://xuse.co.jp/product/053_farthest2015/pageCharacter.html]official site[/url].]
